text:
Maya (PM): Quick sync 9 proposing a lightweight invite playbook for a 6-week latency beta focused on realtime inference use cases. Want feedback on recruitment copy, screener, and launch gates. Aim to start outreach next Mon.
Aaron (PM Research): +1. Can we list target personas explicitly? e.g., customer-facing chat, realtime docs, reranking at high QPS.
Maya (PM): Personas: realtime chat (UI-facing), short-turn workflows (micro-latency), and vector-search + rerank (high QPS).
Priya (Design): Add a 1-line usage checklist to the screener: "Have you shipped an LLM feature to customers?" Yes/No and a short textbox for main constraint.
Elena (Solutions Eng): Ops question: can we promise Dedicated slots? we shouldn't overcommit.
Maya (PM): We can offer a small Dedicated canary pool for up to 2 partners or hosted guidance with documented fallbacks.
Sam (SRE): Need a clear degraded-throughput fallback policy. I'll draft routing rules.
Chris (Legal): Flag 9 if we're collecting any logs or outputs for debugging, include explicit consent + minimal DPIA mention. Keep NDA short but explicit on allowed data.
deploy-bot: deploy job #875 merged to beta/invite-playbook (main -> beta) :party_parrot:
Aaron (PM Research): Screener draft (1-2 min): ```
1) Brief feature description
2) Avg QPS and p95 latency target
3) Typical input length (tokens) and concurrency
4) Regulatory constraints (PHI/PCI/GDPR)
5) Point of contact + dev hours to integrate
```
Priya (Design): LGTM. Add "What does success look like?" as checkboxes: lower latency / cost reduction / accuracy parity.
Elena (Solutions Eng): Scoring idea: fit (1-5), effort (1-5), impact (1-5). Accept combined >=11. Add data-sensitivity veto (on-prem only = veto).
Maya (PM): Agreed. We'll add the veto.
Sam (SRE): Proposed launch gates: Gate 1 (Recruit) 9 >=10 qualified signups across personas; Gate 2 (Onboard) 9 3 partners validated in staging; Gate 3 (Quality) 9 no >10% regression on a key eval across partners; Gate 4 (Ops) 9 runbook + fallback verified and latency SLOs documented. Pause outreach if gates fail.
Aaron (PM Research): Metrics to capture: median latency, cost / 1k tokens, and qualitative NPS at week 4.
Maya (PM): Also require partners run a short eval harness we provide (3 canonical prompts) and upload outputs.
Chris (Legal): I'll write a 1-paragraph consent block + short data-handling note. For dataset requests ping me.
Priya (Design): Incentives: $500 credit for startups or joint case study + co-marketing for enterprises. Offer both as options in outreach.
Elena (Solutions Eng): Outreach templates: cold short email and an extended briefing for inbounds. Also will help triage invites.
Sam (SRE): Ops note: include oncall coverage hours during the 6-week beta and a primary/responder list. I'll stub runbook templates.
Aaron (PM Research): A/B test invite copy: "help shape latency" vs "reduce cost" 9 track conversion and time-to-first-integration.
Maya (PM): Good. Measure conversion and integration time.
Elena (Solutions Eng): Add onboarding checklist for staging: API key scoped, model pinned, baseline eval artifacts uploaded, traffic routing plan (canary %).
Chris (Legal): Add offered retention windows for logs: 30 / 90 / 365 days. Default to 30.
Priya (Design): I'll draft an in-product banner: "You're in our latency beta 9 here's how we collaborate" with CTA to onboarding docs.
Maya (PM): Next steps: I'll consolidate into a 1-page playbook: screener, scoring rubric, launch gates, onboarding checklist, incentives, legal snippet. Owners: Aaron (screener), Priya (banner + copy), Elena (rubric + checklist), Sam (ops/runbook), Chris (consent + retention). Circulate by EOD Fri.
Elena (Solutions Eng): Happy to triage invites.
Sam (SRE): Stubbing runbook now, will ping for review.
Aaron (PM Research): I'll wire the form and A/B in HubSpot.
Priya (Design): +1.
Chris (Legal): Will review final playbook.
Maya (PM): Thanks team. If no objections we'll start outreach next Monday. :rocket:
